source: Giáo trình A1 (2026-10-22, design/de-xuat-giao-trinh-a1.png): 12 chủ đề theo thứ tự ngữ pháp, mỗi chủ đề 3 bài chính và 2–3 bài thêm.

topics.name: Chào hỏi và giới thiệu bản thân
topics.canDoVi: chào hỏi, nói tên, tuổi, quê và giới thiệu một người bạn (I am, she is).

slots.title: Hello! I'm Minh
slots.idea: Minh says hello and tells his name, age, home town and that he is a student.

slots.title: Where Are You From?
slots.idea: New classmates ask each other where they are from; we, they, he and she are all used.

slots.title: This Is My Friend Anna
slots.idea: Minh introduces his friend Anna: where she is from, how old she is, what she is like.

slots.title: At the Language Club
slots.idea: People meet at an English club after school and introduce themselves and each other.

slots.title: A New Classmate
slots.idea: A new student comes to the class; the others say hello and ask about him.

topics.name: Gia đình
topics.canDoVi: giới thiệu gia đình, nói ai có gì (have / has) và đồ vật là của ai (my, his, Lan's).

slots.title: My Family
slots.idea: Lan talks about her family: how many brothers and sisters she has, and what her parents have.

slots.title: My Brother's Room
slots.idea: Lan shows her brother's room and says whose things are there: his bed, our cat, Dad's guitar.

slots.title: A Family Photo
slots.idea: Looking at a family photo: who each person is and what he or she has.

slots.title: Grandma's Birthday
slots.idea: The family has a small party for grandma's birthday.

slots.title: A Day at My Uncle's Farm
slots.idea: A visit to an uncle who has a farm with animals and a big garden.

slots.title: My Cousin Lan
slots.idea: A boy describes his cousin, her family and her things.

topics.name: Thời gian và ngày tháng
topics.canDoVi: hỏi và nói giờ, ngày, tháng, sinh nhật (at 7 o'clock, on Monday, in May).

slots.title: What Time Is It?
slots.idea: A school day told by the clock: at seven, at noon, in the afternoon.

slots.title: My Birthday
slots.idea: Friends ask when, where and who about a birthday party.

slots.title: My Busy Week
slots.idea: A girl plans her week, day by day, and asks her friend about his.

slots.title: A Busy Monday
slots.idea: Everything a mother does on Monday, hour by hour.

slots.title: The School Calendar
slots.idea: Students look at the school calendar: holidays, tests and trips in each month.

topics.name: Nhà cửa và đồ đạc
topics.canDoVi: tả nhà và phòng, nói đồ vật ở đâu (there is a bed next to the window).

slots.title: My House
slots.idea: A boy describes his house: how many rooms there are and what there is in each.

slots.title: In My Room
slots.idea: A girl says where things are in her room: on the desk, under the bed, next to the door.

slots.title: Where Is My Phone?
slots.idea: A family looks for a lost phone around the house.

slots.title: Moving to a New Flat
slots.idea: A family moves to a new flat and puts the furniture in place.

slots.title: My Dream Bedroom
slots.idea: A child describes the bedroom she would like.

slots.title: Cleaning Day
slots.idea: On Sunday the family cleans the house and finds things in strange places.

topics.name: Hoạt động hằng ngày
topics.canDoVi: kể một ngày của mình và của người khác, nói việc gì thường làm (she gets up at 6, I usually walk to school).

slots.title: An Afternoon at Work and Home
slots.idea: What a person does every afternoon at work and then at home.

slots.title: My Mother's Day
slots.idea: A child tells what his mother always, usually and sometimes does in a day.

slots.title: Weekends
slots.idea: Two friends compare what they and their families do at weekends.

slots.title: A Day of a Nurse
slots.idea: The daily routine of a nurse at a hospital.

slots.title: Sunday Morning
slots.idea: What everyone in the family usually does on Sunday morning.

topics.name: Đồ ăn
topics.canDoVi: nói mình ăn gì, gọi món đơn giản, dùng a / an / the và danh từ số nhiều (two apples).

slots.title: Breakfast at Home
slots.idea: A family has breakfast: an egg, a banana, the bread on the table.

slots.title: At the Café
slots.idea: Friends order drinks and cakes at a café: two teas, three sandwiches.

slots.title: A Shopping List
slots.idea: A mother and her son write a shopping list for dinner.

slots.title: Lunch at School
slots.idea: What students eat at the school canteen.

slots.title: Cooking with Mom
slots.idea: A girl helps her mother cook a simple dish.

slots.title: Street Food in Hanoi
slots.idea: A visitor tries street food in Hanoi with a local friend.

topics.name: Mua sắm
topics.canDoVi: hỏi giá, chọn đồ (this one, those shoes) và mua đồ ở chợ, ở cửa hàng.

slots.title: At the Market
slots.idea: A woman buys fruit at the market and asks about this and that.

slots.title: New Clothes
slots.idea: A boy chooses new clothes with his mother: these shoes, that shirt.

slots.title: How Much Is It?
slots.idea: Shopping for school things and asking how much each one is.

slots.title: A Birthday Present
slots.idea: Two friends look for a birthday present for a classmate.

slots.title: At the Bookshop
slots.idea: A girl buys books and pens at a bookshop.

topics.name: Trường học
topics.canDoVi: nói về trường lớp, hỏi và trả lời câu hỏi Yes/No, nói điều mình không làm (I don't like, does he…?).

slots.title: My School
slots.idea: A student describes her school and what students do and don't do there.

slots.title: Do You Like Math?
slots.idea: Friends ask each other about the subjects they like and don't like.

slots.title: Our Teacher
slots.idea: Students talk about their English teacher: what she does and doesn't do.

slots.title: My Favorite Subject
slots.idea: A boy explains why art is his favorite subject.

slots.title: School Clubs
slots.idea: New students ask about the clubs at school.

slots.title: Exam Day
slots.idea: What students do and don't do on the day of a test.

topics.name: Âm nhạc
topics.canDoVi: nói mình thích nghe, chơi loại nhạc gì và vì sao (I love singing because…).

slots.title: My Favorite Song
slots.idea: A girl talks about her favorite song and singer.

slots.title: Listening to Music at Home
slots.idea: When and how a family listens to music at home.

slots.title: Learning Music at School
slots.idea: Music lessons at school: what students like and why.

slots.title: A Concert in the Park
slots.idea: Friends go to a free concert in the park.

slots.title: My Brother Can Sing
slots.idea: A girl talks about her brother who loves singing.

topics.name: Thời tiết
topics.canDoVi: nói thời tiết hôm nay và các mùa, việc mình thường làm khi trời nắng, mưa.

slots.title: Today's Weather
slots.idea: A short weather report for some cities in Vietnam.

slots.title: Seasons in Vietnam
slots.idea: What the weather is usually like in each season and what people often do.

slots.title: A Rainy Day
slots.idea: What a family usually does on a rainy day.

slots.title: A Trip to Da Lat
slots.idea: A family visits Da Lat, where it is often cool.

slots.title: Hot Summer Days
slots.idea: What children do on hot summer days.

topics.name: Con vật
topics.canDoVi: tả con vật, nói con vật làm được gì và không làm được gì (birds can fly, fish can't walk).

slots.title: My Favorite Pet Animals
slots.idea: A child talks about pets and what they can do.

slots.title: Visiting the Big Zoo
slots.idea: A class trip to the zoo: the animals and what they can do.

slots.title: What Can It Do?
slots.idea: A quiz game about animals: what they can and can't do.

slots.title: At the Farm
slots.idea: Children visit a farm with cows, ducks and chickens.

slots.title: A Lost Cat
slots.idea: A family looks for their lost cat with the neighbours.

slots.title: Animals in Vietnam
slots.idea: Some animals that live in Vietnam and what they can do.

topics.name: Thành phố và chỉ đường
topics.canDoVi: hỏi đường và chỉ đường đơn giản (go straight, turn left, it's next to the bank).

slots.title: Go Straight!
slots.idea: A tourist asks the way to a museum and a local person gives directions.

slots.title: At the Bus Stop
slots.idea: Someone asks which bus to take and where to get off.

slots.title: A Walk in Hanoi
slots.idea: A guide takes visitors on a walk around the Old Quarter.

slots.title: Where Is the Post Office?
slots.idea: A boy helps an old woman find the post office.

slots.title: My Way to School
slots.idea: A girl explains how to get from her house to school.
